## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design a practical multilingual NLP feature with interpretability, labeling strategy, and rollout controls in production.

- Hybrid regex + ML approach for hedging
- Multilingual handling and code-switching
- Per-message explanations for explanations
- Lightweight data labeling (active learning)

## Code Example

```javascript
// Pseudocode: combine regex hits with ML score
const hedges = [/maybe/i, /perhaps/i, /could be/i];
function score(message, model) {
  const r = hedges.some(pat => pat.test(message));
  const m = model.predict(message); // returns 0..1 hedging likelihood
  return { score: Math.max(r ? 0.6 : 0, m) };
}
```

- How would you measure false positives in production and adjust thresholds?

## Why This Is Asked

Tests on-device NLP design, privacy guarantees, and multilingual handling with code-switching in a beginner-friendly setting. Assesses ability to blend regex-based detection with a compact NER model and plan labeling, rollout, and evaluation.

## Key Concepts

- On-device inference with WebAssembly
- PII detection: regex patterns + lightweight NER
- Multilingual and code-switching resilience
- Privacy guarantees and staged rollout
- Evaluation metrics: precision/recall for redactions

## Code Example

```javascript
function redactPII(text) {
  const email = /\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b/g;
  const phone = /\b(\+?\d{1,3}[-.\s+]?)?(\(?\d{2,4}\)?[-.\s+]?\d{3,4}[-.\s+]?\d{3,4})\b/g;
  return text
    .replace(email, "[REDACTED_EMAIL]")
    .replace(phone, "[REDACTED_PHONE]");
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you extend to additional languages?
- How would you validate redaction quality without leaking data?

## Why This Is Asked

Enterprise LLM deployments face prompt-injection risks across languages. This question tests end-to-end thinking: multilingual risk taxonomy, privacy-preserving inference, edge latency, policy governance, and a robust evaluation loop with red-team prompts and drift monitoring.

## Key Concepts

- Multilingual risk detection for prompts across EN/DE/JA/ZH
- Edge inference with privacy safeguards (per-tenant isolation)
- Retrieval of policy rules from a central registry and fast updates
- Drift detection and red-team evaluation pipeline

## Code Example

```python
# Pseudocode: simple risk score from keyword regexes per language
import re
from typing import List

class Detector:
    def __init__(self, patterns: List[str]):
        self.regexes = [re.compile(p) for p in patterns]
    def score(self, text: str) -> float:
        return sum(bool(r.search(text)) for r in self.regexes) / len(self.regexes)
```

- How would you measure latency and ensure sub-150 ms on-device inference across languages?
- How would you handle policy rollout and rollback when the registry updates mid-traffic?
